title: Show two fixed-stock cross-contact caller transport failures
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

On the rotated rational caller, the tested idle fusion fails the first D-dependent read and the full endpoint. Its ideal compute/uncompute repair costs two grade-eight shears. On the live BIT caller, retaining the early field and replacing the later idle leaves a residual unavailable in the granted stock. The literal phase control gives the missing D10 direction.

## Task and overlap

Scoped #7852 follow-up at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212` on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. #7830 head `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15` supplies the actual caller. #7839 and Discussion #7111 cover related direct commutations and fixed observations. This follows two named cross-contact transfers and their return and scratch conditions.

## Validation

The SHA-256 checks and `python3 -I -B replay.py` passed from a clean copied directory. Both orientations where applicable, original, commuting and fused controls, symbolic repair, and directed near-trial full BIT deficit. Remaining work includes changed stock and physical allocation/erasure.

## Credit

Credit Ali Romman for the #7756/#7776 caller and the #7830 lineage. Clear1nsight prepared this package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

## Open next questions

Identify another already-paid stock observation that spans the missing residual at the actual clock.
